positions.title: Actuary - Process Improvement
positions.description:
• Managed an intern project to develop prediction models for calculating monthly reserves over $100M using regression models
• Increased reserve prediction accuracy by greater than 50%, eliminated prediction fluctuations from previous models, automated the model update process to minimize manual mistakes, and provided more reliable financial guidelines for strategic decisions  
• Reduced model runtime (from 1+ week to 1 day) by streamlining the data pipeline and KPI dashboard update using SQL and SAS, enabled earlier monitoring of claims development, and allowed more time allocation on strategy design than model updates

positions.title: Actuary - Forecasting and Modeling
positions.description:
• Collaborated with team to build mathematical and regression models to predict financial performance of Medicare Supplement products with over $1B in premium, perform model evaluation through back-testing, and produce quarterly forecast report
• Communicated to both technical and non-technical audiences by advising senior management and matrix partners in developing business strategies based on forecast analysis and contributed to 1.5x growth in annual revenue
• Orchestrated annual solvency testing (cash flow, liability, and asset testing) for entire book of business over $1B in revenue

positions.title: Actuary - Retirement Consulting
positions.description:
• Quantified client's time-value cost and competitive benefits for implementing lump-sum retirement benefits plan for over 10,000 employees
• Delivered business risk analysis, pension solutions proposal, and consulting for mock clients
